name: Wise
source: Wise public comparison feed, A$1000 to JPY: Wise fee A$6.34 at mid-market rate (modelled as % of amount).

note.en: Mid-market rate plus a shown fee. Fee varies with amount and how you pay.
note.ja: ミッドマーケットレート+明示された手数料。手数料は金額や支払方法で変わります。

name: Revolut
source: Revolut AU Standard fees page 2026-11-06: A$0 exchange fee in market hours up to Fair Usage Limit; 0.5% over limit; 1% (1.5% over limit) outside market hours (weekends).

note.en: Standard plan, weekdays, within its fair-usage limit. Weekends add 1%; over the limit adds 0.5%.
note.ja: スタンダードプラン・平日・利用上限内の場合。週末は+1%、上限超過は+0.5%。

name: OFX
source: Wise public comparison feed, A$1000 to JPY: OFX rate markup 1.84% + A$15 fee.

note.en: Rate margin plus a A$15 fee on smaller transfers. Margins can be lower on large amounts.
note.ja: レートの上乗せ+少額送金は15豪ドルの手数料。高額では上乗せが下がる場合があります。

name: bank
source: Average of NAB 2.65%, ANZ 3.11%, CBA 5.18%, Westpac 0.53% (Wise public comparison feed, A$1000 to JPY, bank transfer). Other banks not listed.

note.en: Average of big-four banks with published online rates. Your bank may differ.
note.ja: オンラインレートを公開している大手銀行の平均。銀行により異なります。

name: kiosk
source: Travelex AU online cash rate 2026-11-06: 106.1859 JPY per A$ vs mid 109.467 (Wise feed) = 3.0%. Online is Travelex best rate; in-store/airport rates are higher.

note.en: Travelex online-order cash rate. Walk-up airport counters usually pay less.
note.ja: Travelexのオンライン注文レート。空港カウンターは通常これより不利です。
